overrides.reason: WGAP is documented as dimension (N-1), but dlarrb.f reads RGAP = WGAP( II ) for II up to ILAST-OFFSET (lines 263, 270), which is WGAP(N) when ILAST = N and OFFSET = 0, a valid call. The caller dlarrv documents WGAP as dimension (N) (dlarrv.f:177). The JS wrapper must size WGAP by what the code touches, N (ticket 0068).
